request: Add a rate-limiting decorator to CTFd that caps POST requests per client per time window, and apply it to the login, register and team forms.

summary.result_text:
I couldn't run the import check because the command needed approval, which hasn't been given. The edits are in, but I haven't run any tests.

**What was already there:** `login`, `register` and `teams.join` in `CTFd/auth.py` and `CTFd/teams.py` already used `@ratelimit(method="POST", limit=10, interval=5)`. The decorator itself was defined as `throttle` in `CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`. Every module imported `ratelimit`, so those imports would have raised `ImportError`.

**What I changed:**
- **`CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`:** I renamed `throttle` to `ratelimit` and added a docstring. It counts POST requests per client IP and endpoint, and returns a 429 once a client passes `limit` requests in `interval` seconds. I also changed the default `key_prefix` from `"th"` to `"rl"`, which only changes the cache key names.
- **`CTFd/teams.py`:** I added `@ratelimit(method="POST", limit=10, interval=5)` to the team creation form (`/teams/new`). That was the only form without it.

**Things to know:**
- The 429 response is JSON, even on the HTML forms. That's how the existing code behaved, and I didn't change it.
- The check isn't atomic, so a burst of simultaneous requests can slip slightly past the limit.
- Clients are identified by `request.remote_addr`. Behind a reverse proxy, this only works if the proxy's forwarded address is configured correctly. Otherwise every user shares one counter.

Approve the check and I'll run it, or run `python -c "import CTFd.utils.decorators as d; print(d.ratelimit)"` yourself.

input.command: git status --short | head; ls CTFd/utils/decorators* ; grep -rn "ratelimit" CTFd --include=*.py | grep -v "@ratelimit" | head
grep -n "ratelimit" -B2 -A40 CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py | head -80; git log --oneline | head -3

sed -i 's/def throttle(/def ratelimit(/; s/throttle_decorator/ratelimit_decorator/g; s/throttle_function/ratelimit_function/g' CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='CTFd/teams.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('@teams.route("/teams/new", methods=["GET", "POST"])\n@authed_only\n@require_team_mode\ndef new():','@teams.route("/teams/new", methods=["GET", "POST"])\n@authed_only\n@require_team_mode\n@ratelimit(method="POST", limit=10, interval=5)\ndef new():')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; python -c "import CTFd.utils.decorators as d; print(d.ratelimit)"
python -c "import CTFd.utils.decorators as d; print(d.ratelimit)"; git diff --stat
